title: Process Capability Analysis and Reporting Tool
text: Dynamic Ingestion: Upload CSV files automatically map measurement columns. Smart Filtering: Exclude specific rows using Regex-based numeric filtering remove outliers setup data. Visual Insights: Real-time table highlighting values Cpk thresholds (Red < 1.0, Yellow < 1.33). Professional Export: Generate stylized Excel reports color-coded results ready management review.
